bibl.title: Sense and Reference in Hipponax.
bibl.seg: Vanessa Casato, Sense and Reference in Hipponax.
bibl.note: Looks at the way in which Hipponax problematizes the relation between language and referent and begins to outline what might be thought of as a mischieviousness in relation to linguistic referentiality. His distinctly heightened language creates an impression of fictionality, even while his poetry conveys a kind of "realism" in the way that we feel assaulted by an unfiltered reality, spattered with bodily fluids.
